title: gettext.c2py mistranslates unary `!` before a binary operator (wrong operator precedence)
author: winklemad
body_preview: # Bug report  `gettext.c2py()` compiles a C plural-form expression into an equivalent Python function. In C the unary `!` operator binds **tighter** than every binary operator, so `!n + 1` means `(!n) + 1`.
